fields.description: Laurel is a residential phase at Central Park, City Walk, pairing one- to four-bedroom apartments with two larger penthouses. The plans offer distinct balcony arrangements and both single-level and split-level penthouse layouts. Shared parks and activity spaces connect the homes to the wider neighbourhood.

overview: Outdoor area is a large share of the reviewed duplex penthouse total. Compare its internal suite and terraces separately rather than treating the headline figure as enclosed living space.
research.locationNote: At Central Park in City Walk, Dubai. The park-facing setting and shared community facilities are described in the phase brochure; specific views depend on position and floor.
research.priceNote: Property Finder retains an approximately AED 2m historical launch reference. The current developer page supplies no usable numeric quote. This is not evidence of available developer stock or the price of a particular resale home.
research.paymentNote: The original official sheet gives 20% booking, 10% February 2023, 10% August 2023, 10% May 2024 and 50% November 2025 on handover. Passed dates are retained as historical terms, not a current instalment offer.
research.handoverNote: The original developer payment sheet names November 2025; Property Finder gives December 2025. Meraas lists Laurel sold out and still describes final works and approvals. Actual unit completion remains unconfirmed.
